description: Centros de protección civil is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Diputación Provincial de Badajoz. Civil protection centers in municipalities with a population of less than 50,000 inhabitants of the province of Badajoz, based on the Survey of Infrastructure and Local Equipment. Coverage: Diputación Provincial de Badajoz. The portal shows the English title as "Civil protection centres" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Diputación Provincial de Badajoz. Its keywords include Badajoz, Extremadura, seguridad, prevención, emergencias, EIEL. The listing shows 2024-11-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://datosabiertos.dip-badajoz.es/es/pages/reutiliza-es). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
